title: Scope; effective dates.
bodyText: This part shall apply to all homeowners insurance policies delivered or issued for delivery in this State after July 31, 2012.
bodyHtml: [§431:10E-122]  Scope; effective dates.  This part shall apply to all homeowners insurance policies delivered or issued for delivery in this State after July 31, 2012. [L 2012, c 80, pt of §1]
